GONDOLA.gloss: a low flat-bottomed freight car with fixed sides but no roof
GONDOLA.definition: A low flat-bottomed freight car with fixed sides but no roof.

LAGOON.gloss: a body of water cut off from a larger body by a reef of sand or coral
LAGOON.definition: A body of water cut off from a larger body by a reef of sand or coral.

ALONG.example: We drove along admiring the view.

GLAND.gloss: any of various organs that synthesize substances needed by the body and release it…
GLAND.definition: Any of various organs that synthesize substances needed by the body and release it through ducts or directly into the bloodstream.

GOOD.gloss: having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified
GOOD.definition: Having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified.

LONG.definition: Primarily temporal sense; being or indicating a relatively great or greater than average duration or passage of time or a duration as specified.

LAND.gloss: the land on which real estate is located
LAND.definition: The land on which real estate is located.
LAND.example: He built the house on land leased from the city.

OLD.gloss: having lived for a relatively long time or attained a specific age
OLD.definition: (used especially of persons) having lived for a relatively long time or attained a specific age.

GOD.gloss: any supernatural being worshipped as controlling some part of the world or some aspect…
GOD.definition: Any supernatural being worshipped as controlling some part of the world or some aspect of life or who is the personification of a force.

DOG.gloss: a member of the genus Canis that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times
DOG.definition: A member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds.

GOAL.gloss: the state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that terminates behavior…
GOAL.definition: The state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it.

GLAD.gloss: showing or causing joy and pleasure
GLAD.definition: Showing or causing joy and pleasure; especially made happy.

LOAN.definition: The temporary provision of money (usually at interest).

DON.gloss: teacher at a university or college
DON.definition: Teacher at a university or college (especially at Cambridge or Oxford).

LOAD.gloss: weight to be borne or conveyed
LOAD.definition: Weight to be borne or conveyed.
